stages.name: derive
stages.description: Mesh-only derivation of occlusion, occupancy, part masks, socket-wall masks, and landmark UVs

parameter_sources.FEATHER: measurement: S/derive/RESULT2.md (lips 6, eyes 6, socket 8, brows 16, ears 16, default 32)
parameter_sources.eye_pattern: measurement: S/eyetex/RESULT2.md NAMES globe makeclothes_library_eyes_high_poly globe mesh; eye mesh matches /eyes_(low|high)_poly/i (globe)
parameter_sources.lipuv_npz: method: same mouth-loop ring as mask-lips, split upper/lower by ring-centre height, row=v*S (stored solve3 lipuv was landmark-box derived and row=(1-v)*S per S/derive/RESULT.md G4 line 8)

stages.name: occlusion
stages.description: Apply AO map to albedo: albedo *= AO^p, a* += k*(1-AO), occupancy-gated

parameter_sources.k: measurement: S/shade/RESULT.md k=2 confirmed by three-strength test S/brow2/RESULT.md

stages.name: roughness
stages.description: Build roughness map: 0.62 - Tc*T + 0.08*C + 0.05*H clipped [0.3, 0.8], lips 0.45

parameter_sources.tcoef: measurement: S/shade/RESULT.md Tc=0.08 chosen (nose 15.38/15.62/16.34, duller wins)
parameter_sources.tzone: method: disks at derived nose-tip/chin/brow-pushed-forehead landmarks (radii 0.035/0.030/0.055 of S), facecore-gated, dilate-5/blur-12 as scratch; replaces MediaPipe gate polygons (subject-constant boxes) per S/shade/build_roughness.py

stages.name: lips
stages.description: Scale lip chroma by ratio under feathered lip mask (sigma 6)

parameter_sources.ratio: measurement: S/skins/RESULT.md 1.30 tuned on female skin, correctly skipped on male (default 1.0 = no change)
parameter_sources.default_ratio: operator/consult decision: 1.0 = no change, with value recorded per subject

stages.name: eye_corners
stages.description: Paint socket-wall texels visible through eye corners as conjunctiva (caruncle pink medially, pale conjunctiva laterally)

parameter_sources.outer_rgb: operator/consult decision: pale lateral conjunctiva (~0.5x renders ~108,93,85)
parameter_sources.zone_bounds: measurement: S/eyegeo/fix_corner.py [0.009, 0.018, 0.0002, 0.006, -0.003, 0.006] vs subject eye mesh
parameter_sources.innersplit: method: texel to nearer derived eye-corner inner/outer landmark (replaces 3-D sidedness vs eye centroid)

stages.name: symmetrise
stages.description: Mirror-average low band (sigma>=40) of L,a,b across face core using mesh correspondence

parameter_sources.w_feather: measurement: S/sym/fix_sym.py 32.0 (~96 texel feather at 3 sigma)

stages.name: socket
stages.description: Socket-red fix: fill eye-band texels (dilate 8) with cheek hue/chroma at L45

parameter_sources.cheek_lab: measurement: S/polish/RESULT.md D1 fix line 'socket-red texels (eye-band verts, dilate 8) filled with cheek hue/chroma at L45 (132,100,80), feather 6' + 'adjacent skin 12.7/14.0' (L45 with adjacent a*/b*)
parameter_sources.dilate_px: measurement: S/polish/RESULT.md D1 fix line 'eye-band verts, dilate 8'
parameter_sources.band_substitution: method: eye-band vertex selection rule NOT recorded (no mesh/window/threshold) so band = derived eye-mask union dilated 8; fill numbers above are verbatim from the D1 fix line

sources.glb_sha256: measured: shasum -a 256 S/body2/final.glb (male-macro rebake, bake.log MACRO_BASE gender 1.0)
sources.lips.ratio: measurement: S/skins/RESULT.md G2 — pre-lips lip a* 13.11 vs goal 13.64, ratio 1.30 would push to 17.0; 1.0 = no-op recorded per subject
sources.symmetrise.strength: operator/consult decision: 1.0 default per S/sym/fix_sym.py (same as aisha; recorded per subject)

ao_bake.note: AO bake needs Blender; tracked test must not launch it. Record command + parameters in manifest. Human/station runs this separately.
